notes.title: Mutant Fighting Cup 2 RELEASED on Steam!
notes.content:
The wait is over! Now you can get the game and play all characters, including awesome new mutant Turtle! 
Earn all achievements, get all cards and don't forget to share a screenshot of your own unique mutant with your friends on Steam!
See you in the game!

notes.title: When is it out?
notes.content:
Hello guys!
As always, we had technical problems with mac os version of the game, that came out in last second XD We already fixed them, but now we are waiting Valve to approve new game build. The game will be available as soon as it will be fully approved!
Thank you for your patience and sorry for delays!
